intent_no_disproportionate_late_capture.quote: Rewards for each epoch are calculated using the user's veTRUST balance at the **end of the epoch**. Because the system relies on a single timestamp snapshot, users who bond immediately before epoch close can receive the same reward share as users who participated throughout the entire epoch.
This allows attackers to capture a disproportionate share of emissions while only participating for a negligible portion of the epoch.

dilute_rewards_honest_participants.quote: Late bonding allows attackers to dilute rewards for honest participants.

attacker_captures_majority_rewards.quote: Despite Alice participating for the entire epoch, Bob captures the majority of rewards after bonding only seconds before epoch close.
